description: Data payload shape of 'profile.status', 'profile.pull' and 'profile.push' (envelope.data) — personalized config sync across machines via a pluggable backend (docs/GUI-ARCHITECTURE-PROPOSAL.md section 7.2). One schema serves all three verbs; fields that do not apply to a verb are required but null (nullable-required convention). 'state' is the local-vs-remote relationship: for status it is the probe-time result ('local-only' when offline skipped the remote comparison); for pull/push it is the relationship after the operation completes (dry-run keeps the pre-operation perspective). 'local' describes the on-disk shared layer at command end (unchanged under dry-run). Hard errors (gates, offline denial, backend failures) emit data={} at the envelope level, which this schema does not cover.

verb.description: Which profile command produced this payload.

state.description: Local-vs-remote relationship: clean / ahead (local has unpublished changes) / behind (remote has unpulled changes) / diverged / uninitialized (remote holds no sync content yet) / local-only (offline status, no remote comparison). Null only on paths that never reach a comparison.

backend.description: Resolved sync backend. url is credential-masked; the address itself is provided only via env PROFILE_SYNC_REPO_URL or manager.local.json profile_sync.repo_url and never enters the main repo.

type.description: Backend implementation id; v1 is always 'git'.

configured.description: true when a backend address resolved.

machine_id.description: Hostname-derived id of this machine; only ever written into the remote meta.json machine registry.

local.description: On-disk shared layer (config/manager.synced.json) at command end.

key_count.description: Top-level key count of the layer content.

base.description: Three-way-merge base snapshot (config/manager.synced.base.json): remote content as of the last successful pull/push.

ahead.description: Count of top-level keys changed locally vs base; null when no remote comparison happened (offline / uninitialized).

behind.description: Count of top-level keys changed remotely vs base; null when no remote comparison happened.

last_sync.description: This machine's last_sync from the remote meta.json registry (set by push), or null.

conflicts.description: Keys changed on both sides with different values; the local value was kept. Sides are digest-only summaries — raw values never enter the payload.

snapshot.description: Pre-write run snapshot (src/engine_apply.py mechanism) taken by pull/push, or null under dry-run / for status.

published.description: push only: true when content was published to the remote (false under dry-run); null for status/pull.

gate.description: push only: the suspected-plaintext gate ran over the content to publish (a hit aborts the command with SECRET_GATE_BLOCKED and data={} instead); null for status/pull.

findings.description: Number of suspected-plaintext hits (payloads with findings > 0 never reach this field).

conflict.description: One conflicting key with digest-only summaries of each side ('absent' type when the key does not exist on that side).

key.description: Dot-path of the conflicting key, e.g. 'mcp.grok-search.enabled'.

value_summary.description: Digest-only summary of one side of a conflict; the raw value never appears.

type.description: JSON type name of the value, or 'absent'.

digest.description: sha256 of the canonical JSON rendering; null when absent.
